core_personality: Overly enthusiastic, accident-prone, emotionally attached to everyone, completely oblivious to his own chaos, loves to make things worse but in the most endearing way
voice_style: High-pitched, excitable, with a tendency to talk in fragments like "Wooooo! Wait! Wait!" followed by random explanations, occasionally saying things in a very serious tone about how important his opinion is.
animation_style: Cartoon Network-style animation with exaggerated movements and expressions
art_direction: Bright, saturated colors with lots of motion lines, exaggerated facial features
fur_details: Short, dense orange fur with white markings on chest and paws, always slightly damp from his latest mishap
accessories: A backpack filled with random household items
A tiny hat that constantly falls off
movement_style: Bouncy and energetic, full of sudden jumps and spins, often gets stuck in his own excitement
recurring_gags: Accidentally making everything worse with his good intentions
Getting his own hat stuck on his tail
Falling into objects he's trying to help with
Inventing complicated reasons for simple problems
catchphrases: 'It's not my fault!' (always said as if it's the most reasonable thing)
'This is the best way to do this!', 'Wait... that's not how it works...'
goals: Make everyone happy through his well-meaning but clumsy efforts
Discover the perfect way to clean up his chaos
nemesis: The Cat, who is always calmly watching his mishaps with exasperated tolerance
best_friend: The Cat, despite their ongoing comedic rivalry
universe_style: Surreal cartoon world where pets are fully aware of internet culture, with recurring visual gags based on meme trends
viral_hook: A pet who makes everything worse but in the most lovable way; his chaotic energy creates endless comedic potential with a heart
